source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥דבַּֽיהוָ֨ה׀חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נ֝֗וּדִי הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of David. In YHWH I have taken refuge; how can you say to my soul, Flee [to] your mountain, bird!

en.L: For the director. Of David. In {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I have taken refuge; how can you say to my soul, "Flee [to] your mountain, [like a] bird!
en.B: For the music director. Of David. I have taken refuge in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. How can you say to me, "Escape to the hills like a bird!
en.R: For the leader of the music. By David. I have come to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for safety. So how can you tell me, "Run away to the hills like a bird!

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. De David. Auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} je me suis réfugié ; comment pouvez-vous dire à mon âme : « Fuis [vers] ta montagne, [comme un] oiseau !
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. C’est auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que j’ai trouvé refuge. Comment pouvez-vous me dire : « Échappe-toi vers les collines comme un oiseau !
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. De David. Je suis venu me mettre à l’abri auprès {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Alors comment pouvez-vous me dire : « Sauve-toi dans les collines comme un oiseau !

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nimekimbilia; mwawezaje kuiambia nafsi yangu, "Kimbia [uende] mlimani kwako, [kama] ndege!
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Nimekimbilia kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mwawezaje kuniambia, "Kimbilia milimani kama ndege!
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ya Daudi. Nimekuja kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili nipate usalama. Basi mwawezaje kuniambia, "Kimbia uende milimani kama ndege!

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: I have taken refuge: I have run to the LORD for shelter
decisions.reason: As in 7:2. It is the reason he will not flee.

decisions.choice: Flee to your mountain, bird: the advice of friends
alternatives: flee like a bird to your mountain
decisions.reason: The words, to the end of verse 3, are what others are saying to him: escape to the hills, as a bird flies from the hunter. The Hebrew has no "like"; the bird is addressed directly, and the ancient Greek translation supplies "like".

decisions.choice: flee: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes "flee" as a plural command and its notes say to read it as singular, addressed to "my soul". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: like a bird
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the picture a comparison (m3); Literal brackets "like a".

source.text: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ההָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, the wicked bend [the] bow; they have set their arrow on [the] string to shoot in darkness at [the] upright of heart.

en.L: For look, the wicked bend the bow; they have fitted their arrow on the string to shoot in darkness at the upright of heart.
en.B: Look, the wicked have their bows bent and their arrows set on the string, ready to shoot under cover of darkness at those whose hearts are right.
en.R: Look! Wicked people have their bows and arrows ready. They hide in the dark and shoot at good, honest people.

fr.L: Car voici, les méchants tendent l’arc ; ils ont ajusté leur flèche sur la corde pour tirer dans l’obscurité sur les cœurs droits.
fr.B: Regarde, les méchants ont bandé leur arc et posé leurs flèches sur la corde, prêts à tirer à la faveur de la nuit sur ceux qui ont le cœur droit.
fr.R: Regarde ! Les méchants ont leurs arcs et leurs flèches tout prêts. Ils se cachent dans le noir et tirent sur les gens bons et honnêtes.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, waovu wanaupinda upinde; wameutia mshale wao kwenye uzi ili kuwapiga gizani wanyofu wa moyo.
sw.B: Tazama, waovu wamepinda pinde zao na kutia mishale yao kwenye uzi, tayari kuwapiga gizani wale wenye mioyo minyofu.
sw.R: Tazama! Watu waovu wameweka tayari pinde na mishale yao. Wanajificha gizani na kuwapiga watu wema na waaminifu.

decisions.choice: in darkness: in secret
decisions.reason: To shoot in darkness is to attack where no one can see, as slanderers do.

decisions.choice: upright of heart
decisions.reason: As in 7:11.

decisions.choice: For look: the advisers go on
decisions.reason: These are still the words of those who urge him to flee.

records.literal_gloss: For the foundations are torn down; [the] righteous, what can he do?

en.L: When the foundations are torn down, [the] righteous — what can [one] do?"
en.B: If the very pillars that hold things up are pulled down, what can the righteous accomplish?"
en.R: When everything good and right is being destroyed, what can good people do?"

fr.L: Quand les fondements sont renversés, le juste, que peut-il faire ? »
fr.B: Si les piliers mêmes qui soutiennent tout sont abattus, que peut accomplir le juste ? »
fr.R: Quand tout ce qui est bon et juste est en train d’être détruit, que peuvent faire les gens bons ? »

sw.L: Misingi inapobomolewa, mwenye haki — anaweza kufanya nini?"
sw.B: Ikiwa nguzo zenyewe zinazoshikilia mambo zinabomolewa, mwenye haki anaweza kufanya nini?"
sw.R: Wakati kila kilicho chema na cha haki kinaharibiwa, watu wema wanaweza kufanya nini?"

decisions.choice: the foundations: the order that holds society up
decisions.reason: The word (shatot) is rare; it seems to mean foundations or pillars, here the law and justice that hold a society together (compare 82:5).

decisions.choice: what can he do?: a counsel of despair
alternatives: what has the righteous one done?
decisions.reason: The verb is in the past form and may mean "what has he done" or "what can he do". The advisers' point is that resistance is useless; verses 4-7 answer them.

decisions.choice: everything good and right
decisions.reason: Readable says what the foundations stand for (m1).

source.text: יְהוָ֤ה׀בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH [is] in his holy temple; YHWH, in heaven [is] his throne; his eyes see, his eyelids test [the] children of man.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in [the] heavens [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes see, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyelids test the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple; the throne of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is in heaven. His eyes watch; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} gaze examines every human being.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy temple. His throne is in heaven. He watches everyone on earth and knows what they are really like.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint temple ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans [les] cieux [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône ; {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux voient, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paupières sondent les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint temple ; le trône {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est dans le ciel. Ses yeux observent ; {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} regard examine chaque être humain.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple saint. Son trône est dans le ciel. Il regarde tous les habitants de la terre et sait comment ils sont vraiment.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yuko] katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi [kiko] mbinguni; macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanaona, kope {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zinawapima wanadamu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu; kiti cha enzi cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kiko mbinguni. Macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanatazama; mtazamo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unamchunguza kila mwanadamu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yuko katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu. Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi kiko mbinguni. Anamtazama kila mtu duniani na kujua jinsi alivyo hasa.

decisions.choice: his holy temple: God's dwelling in heaven
decisions.reason: Set beside "in heaven is his throne", the temple is God's heavenly palace, of which the earthly one is a picture (Habakkuk 2:20; Micah 1:2). The foundations on earth may shake, but his throne does not.

decisions.choice: his eyelids test: he looks closely
decisions.reason: Narrowed eyelids are a searching look; God examines people to know them truly.

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The phrase (bene 'adam) means human beings in general.

decisions.choice: every human being (B); everyone on earth (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means (m3).

source.text: יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH tests [the] righteous, and [the] wicked and [the] lover of violence his soul hates.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} tests the righteous, but the wicked and the one who loves violence {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} soul hates.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} tests the righteous, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} hates with all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} being the wicked and those who love violence.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} tests good people to see what they are like. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} truly hates wicked people who love to hurt others.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} éprouve le juste, mais le méchant et celui qui aime la violence, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} âme les hait.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} met le juste à l’épreuve, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} hait de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} être le méchant et ceux qui aiment la violence.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} met les gens bons à l’épreuve pour voir comment ils sont. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} déteste vraiment les méchants qui aiment faire du mal aux autres.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humjaribu mwenye haki, lakini mwovu na apendaye jeuri nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inamchukia.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwajaribu wenye haki, lakini anawachukia kwa moyo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote waovu na wale wapendao jeuri.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwajaribu watu wema ili aone walivyo. Lakini anawachukia kweli watu waovu wanaopenda kuwaumiza wengine.

decisions.choice: tests: proves, as metal is tested
decisions.reason: To test (bachan) is to prove something by trial, as silver is refined (Zechariah 13:9). For the righteous the testing proves them true.

decisions.choice: his soul hates: he hates with his whole self
decisions.reason: "His soul" is God himself (compare 5:6, where the meaning of God's hatred is explained).

decisions.choice: violence: wrong done by force
decisions.reason: The word (chamas) is violent injustice, the sin that filled the earth before the flood (Genesis 6:11).

source.text: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: He will rain on wicked [people] snares; fire and sulfur and a wind of scorching [will be the] portion of their cup.

en.L: He will rain snares on [the] wicked; fire and sulfur and a scorching wind [will be] the portion of their cup.
en.B: On the wicked {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rain down snares; fire, burning sulfur and a scorching wind will be the cup they are given.
en.R: He will pour down traps on wicked people like rain. Fire, burning sulfur and a burning hot wind are what they will get.

fr.L: Il fera pleuvoir des pièges sur [les] méchants ; feu et soufre et vent brûlant [seront] la part de leur coupe.
fr.B: Sur les méchants {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera pleuvoir des pièges ; le feu, le soufre brûlant et un vent desséchant, voilà la coupe qui leur sera servie.
fr.R: Il fera tomber des pièges sur les méchants comme de la pluie. Le feu, le soufre brûlant et un vent très chaud, voilà ce qu’ils recevront.

sw.L: Atanyesha mitego juu ya waovu; moto na kiberiti na upepo wenye joto kali [vitakuwa] fungu la kikombe chao.
sw.B: Juu ya waovu atanyesha mitego; moto, kiberiti kiwakacho na upepo wenye joto kali vitakuwa kikombe watakachopewa.
sw.R: Atawanyeshea watu waovu mitego kama mvua. Moto, kiberiti kinachowaka na upepo wa joto kali ndivyo watakavyopata.

decisions.choice: snares: traps
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word (pachim) means snares or traps. With a small change it would read "coals", which suits the fire and sulfur, and some ancient translations read it so. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: fire and sulfur: the judgment on Sodom
decisions.reason: The LORD rained fire and sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah (Genesis 19:24).

decisions.choice: the portion of their cup: what they are given to drink
decisions.reason: A person's cup is the lot God gives, of blessing (16:5) or of judgment (75:9).

source.text: כִּֽי־צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For righteous [is] YHWH; righteous deeds he loves; [the] upright will see his face.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] righteous; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves righteous deeds; [the] upright will see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is righteous and loves what is right; those who are upright will look on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is fair, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves it when people do what is right. Good, honest people will be with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] juste ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime les actes de justice ; ceux qui sont droits verront {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste et aime ce qui est juste ; ceux qui ont le cœur droit contempleront {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est juste, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime que les gens fassent ce qui est bien. Les gens bons et honnêtes seront avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et verront {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} visage.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwenye haki; anapenda matendo ya haki; wanyofu watauona uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki na anapenda yaliyo haki; wale walio wanyofu watautazama uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwenye haki, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} hupenda watu wanapotenda yaliyo haki. Watu wema na waaminifu watakuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} na kuuona uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

decisions.choice: the upright will see his face: they will be welcome in his presence
decisions.reason: To see someone's face is to be admitted to their presence and favor, as a subject to a king (17:15). The words can also be read "his face looks on the upright"; either way the upright are under his favor.

decisions.choice: righteous deeds: acts of justice
decisions.reason: The plural (tsedaqot) means righteous acts, the things a just person does.

decisions.choice: will be with him and
decisions.reason: Readable says what seeing his face means (m1).

decisions.choice: "ceux qui sont droits" (Literal), "ceux qui ont le cœur droit" (Balanced) for the upright
decisions.reason: The terms note allows both; French uses the forms that do not say "men", since the word includes everyone who lives uprightly, and no gender span is then needed.
